name: SPACE MARINES: OUTRIDER SQUAD
description:
Outrider Squads are swift armoured bikers who are as durable as they are versatile and hard-hitting. They excel in reconnaissance, ranging encirclements, and swift elimination of enemy patrols. Raider-pattern bikes allow Outriders to outmanoeuvre their adversaries and strike with unstoppable force, twin bolt rifles stitching a trail of death.

Full-throttle Assault

This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Outriders for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. These highly mobile warriors allow you to control the flow of battle with their wide threat range, and strike at vulnerable enemy flanks before they have a chance to react. Armed with heavy bolt pistols and chainswords, as well as the twin bolt rifles mounted to their bikes, they are as deadly at range as they are in melee. You'll find Outrider Squads a powerful and flexible unit that deserves a place in any strike force.

Customise your Wargear

Each bike can be assembled upright, or tilting left or right. One miniature can be assembled as either a standard Outrider or Outrider Sergeant with a tilting shield and unique helmet. The Sergeant can replace his chainsword with a thunder hammer, power sword, or power axe. One Outrider can replace their heavy bolt pistol with a plasma pistol. This versatile kit also includes many interchangeable parts, allowing you to mix up your miniatures so no two units need look alike.

Interchangeable parts:
– 7 bare heads
– 3 helmeted heads
– 3 left shoulder pads
– 4 right shoulder pads
– 3 backpacks
– 2 left arms holding handlebars
– 3 right arms holding handlebars
– 6 left arms
– 4 left hands with chainsword
– 1 right arm with plasma pistol
– 2 right arms with heavy bolt pistol
– 2 swords in sheaths
– 3 empty sword sheaths
– 3 pistols in holsters
– 2 empty pistol holsters
– 6 optional pouches, grenades, and accessories

Contents:
– 128 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 90mm by 52.5mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Space Marines Infantry Transfer Sheet

The Space Marines Infantry Transfer Sheet features 664 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors, as well as unit designations, numbers, honour markings, and campaign badges to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
